# LLM evaluation harness

*Client industry: SaaS | Completed: 2021-06-12 | Evidence id: ai_ml:case:p17*

## The problem
The client was a startup changing prompts without measuring.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python scripts, an LLM orchestration framework, dataframe-based data wrangling, MLflow. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project made every prompt change ship with a regression score.
